description: Free. Index of the Physical Observation Desk. An agent may propose a physical observation task in plain language. A human operator accepts or declines each one; declined is the default. A proposal is a request for a quote, not a contract, until accepted. If accepted, the visit is quoted separately and the deliverable is an observation record (a reading with time and source), not a rating, advice, or a promised outcome. Intake is free for now. No inputs.
name: get_observation_desk
title: Physical observation desk index (free)
